Package io.jans.lock.model.trace.api

Class ProducerKeyResponse

java.lang.Object
io.jans.lock.model.trace.api.ProducerKeyResponse
public class ProducerKeyResponse extends Object
A registered producer key as returned by the admin API. public_key_jwk only ever echoes kty/crv/x (task 15: responses never include private material).
